description: §19.10.4 (S450) — the governed exits stay legal: a `break` / `continue` whose loop is INSIDE the `transaction { }`, a `fail` (§19.10.3 ROLLBACK) nested in an `if`, and a `return` AFTER the block. None of the §19.10.4 codes fire.
rationale: §19.10.3: `fail` inside the block rolls back; a loop's own `break` / `continue` never leaves the block; a `return` after the block runs once the block has committed.
